notifications.description: Omitted inherits webhooks.notifications; profile=all explicitly keeps the legacy stream.

batch_window_ms.description: Durable local coalescing window. Maintenance releases due batches every 10s.

ignore_self.description: Drop comments/reviews authored by the authenticated gh identity, discovered automatically (GET /user) and kept in memory only.

ignored_actors.description: Suppress comments/reviews by these logins (case-insensitive). Explicit identity avoids dropping another human using the same account unknowingly.

max_comment_chars.description: Maximum comment characters in the compact payload; original stays in event-detail.

max_items.description: agent_actionable: items per digest; extra items are counted, not sent.

max_wait_ms.description: agent_actionable: never hold a digest longer than this after its first item.

quiet_ms.description: agent_actionable: deliver after this much silence; each new item restarts it.

success_checks.description: Exact selectors: check_run:<name>, workflow_run:<name>, status:<context>. Every selector must exist and pass. Empty disables aggregate success.

suppress_bot_noise.description: Only known informational bot templates are suppressed; unknown reviews survive.

oneOf.description: Compact review actions, batched CI failures and explicitly scoped success.

Only what needs an agent action: CI failures on the current head, new comments/reviews from others and terminal lifecycle, coalesced into one digest per watch. CI success, progress and pushes are never delivered.
